verdict.rationale: JumpCloud ships native, cross-OS MDM/UEM (Windows, Linux, macOS, iOS, iPadOS, Android) on the same platform as its directory, consolidating identities and device management into one source of truth. Conditional access ties device compliance to identity-based access revocation, and community users confirm the MDM works across Mac/Windows/Linux from a single pane. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of device enrollment flows, explicit remote lock/wipe capability, detailed policy-enforcement documentation.
